name: TaskList
description: Navigation rail for a long form done in parts, in any order and over several sessions: each part with its status, the open part with its steps.

keyboard: Tab moves through the parts and the open part's steps in order.
Enter / Space opens the focused part or step.
ariaRequirements: The step on screen carries aria-current="step"; with no step, the open part does.
Each part's status (and hint) describes its button through aria-describedby.
Completed steps add a visually hidden "done"; the check icon is decorative.

tasks.description: Tasks in order. Each has id, label, status, an optional hint and steps, and `unnumbered` to leave a closing task such as "Check and submit" without a number.

label.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark, for example "Intake parts".

currentTaskId.description: The task the person is working on; its steps are listed.

currentStepId.description: The step on screen, marked with aria-current="step".

onSelect.description:
Called when a task or step is chosen. Every task can be opened, so past
steps stay reachable (Baymard: people click step indicators to go back).
Tasks with status "cannotStart" are not interactive.

forbiddenUse: use it for a short linear flow that must be done in order; a simple "Step 2 of 3" caption is enough there.
show a status nobody can act on; "Cannot start yet" is for a part that depends on another.
